'''''Myosotis maritima''''' is a species of [[flowering plant]] in the family [[Boraginaceae]] endemic to the [[Azores]]. It is found in rocks, cliffs and coastal landslides, at altitudes generally below {{convert|50|m|abbr=on}} (on the island of [[Flores Island (Azores)|Flores]], however, there are populations at altitudes close to {{convert|200|m|abbr=on}}). It is present in all of the islands.<ref>{{cite web |title=Myosotis maritima Hochst. ex Seub. |url=https://acores.flora-on.pt/#/1Myosotis+maritima |publisher=[[Flora-On]] |access-date=24 March 2021}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=SMyosotis maritima Hochst. ex Seub. |url=https://www.catalogueoflife.org/data/taxon/455Z6 |publisher=[[Catalogue of Life]] |access-date=24 March 2021}}</ref>
